titles.title: JediAcademy
titles.engine: id Tech 3 (Raven), retail 1.01: jasp.exe 'JA: v1.0.1.0' (SP) and jamp.exe 'JAmp: v1.0.1.0' (MP). The MP modules uix86.dll, cgamex86 and jampgamex86 come from base/assets3.pk3. Both binaries register r_mode with a plain 3-argument Cvar_Get, so there is no range clamp. The engine table covers modes 0-12, and 12 is 2400x600 (surround).
titles.launch_sets:
Result: 1920x1080 fullscreen on .145, .195 and .240 whenever that box's EDID is read. On .123 JKA deploys but both shortcuts are suppressed, because the box has no disc mounter (requires disc_mount).

How: 'Play Jedi Academy.bat' and 'Play Jedi Academy - Multiplayer.bat' both call FLEETRES.BAT. Each writes base\fleetres.cfg with: seta r_mode "-1", r_customwidth %FR_W%, r_customheight %FR_H%, r_customaspect 1, r_customPixelAspect 1, r_fullscreen 1, r_displayRefresh %FR_HZ%, cg_fov %FR_FOV%. The same values are passed as +set on the jasp/jamp command line. base\autoexec.cfg ends 'exec fleetres.cfg' and has no seta r_mode. At sync time the agent writes the same file (gameres.h rule {JediAcademy, base\fleetres.cfg, standard custom body}).

State of the staged tree: present and current. stage-fleetres.py --check reports nothing stale for JKA, and the staged FLEETRES.EXE (md5 bb180f3b...) matches the repo build. PER-TITLE-STATUS records jasp and jamp both measured at 1920x1080 on .145 (not re-measured here).

Caveat for .240: if its EDID is not read, FLEETRES falls back to a 4:3 CRT target no larger than the persisted desktop, so JKA gets 1024x768 there. That is a box fault, not the title.
titles.menu_source:
A hardcoded cvarFloatList on ui_r_mode. 'uiScript updatevideosetup' copies it to r_mode and runs vid_restart on Apply.

The same list appears in four files:
- base/assets1.pk3 ui/setup.menu (SP main Setup)
- base/assets1.pk3 ui/ingamesetup.menu (SP in-game)
- base/assets3.pk3 ui/jamp/setup.menu (MP; the 1.01 copy overrides assets1's)
- base/assets1.pk3 ui/jamp/ingame_setup.menu (MP in-game)

The list: { @MENUS_640_X_480 3 @MENUS_800_X_600 4 @MENUS_1024_X_768 6 @MENUS_1152_X_864 7 @MENUS_1280_X_1024 8 @MENUS_1600_X_1200 9 @MENUS_2048_X_1536 10 @MENUS_2400_X_600 12 }. The labels come from strings/English/MENUS.str: "640 X 480" ... "2048 X 1536", "2400 X 600(surround)".

There is no 1920x1080 entry and no -1 entry. The engine table has no 1920x1080 either. So while the launcher runs r_mode -1, the Video Mode line matches nothing and shows an empty value. The Setup menu opens on the Video tab by default in both SP and MP.
titles.evidence:
All evidence is in /home/voidsstr/development/retro-agent/.claude/evidence-1080p/idtech3-jka-sof2-rtcw/:
- jka-menu-modelists.txt: all four menu lists and the label strings.
- engine-mode-tables.txt: the jasp and jamp r_mode tables (0..12).
- binaries.txt: md5, size and version of both binaries.
- stage-fleetres-check.txt: 213 current; the only failure is Thief2.

Staged files read:
- 'Play Jedi Academy.bat' and 'Play Jedi Academy - Multiplayer.bat'. They differ only in GAME=jasp.exe or jamp.exe; both use GAMEARGS=+set r_mode -1 +set r_customwidth %FR_W% ...
- base/autoexec.cfg: 'exec fleetres.cfg' is the last line.

Also checked:
- jamp r_mode registration at 0x4a229a is a plain Cvar_Get("r_mode",...,0x21).
- Neither default.cfg, low.cfg nor mpdefault.cfg in the assets pk3s sets r_mode.
- The fleet jka-server runs 'seta sv_pure 0' (/home/voidsstr/jka-server/base/server.cfg).

Sibling snapshots from this session: 145-q3/00-gameres-before.json (.145 target 1920x1080), q3-195/00-gameres-before.json (.195 target 1920x1080), 240-q3/01b-gameres.json (.240 EDID DELL E2313H, 1920x1080 offered).
titles.fix:
No engine or launcher change is needed; the renderer already runs r_mode -1 at the panel size. Only the menu is missing the entry.

Stage one override pk3 in base\ whose name sorts after assets3.pk3, e.g. base\zz_fleet_video.pk3. It holds edited copies of four menus:
- ui/setup.menu and ui/ingamesetup.menu (copied from assets1)
- ui/jamp/setup.menu (copied from assets3, the 1.01 version; NOT the assets1 copy)
- ui/jamp/ingame_setup.menu (copied from assets1)

In each video_mode cvarFloatList, add one entry for -1. `@MENUS_CUSTOM -1` works because the "Custom" string already exists in MENUS.str. Then add two items in the 'video' group that show r_customwidth and r_customheight (read-only text, or ITEM_TYPE_EDITFIELD as Knightmare did for RTCW). On the four LCD boxes the line then reads Custom 1920 x 1080.

Do not label the -1 entry literally '1920 X 1080'. It means whatever FLEETRES writes on each box, so on the CRT boxes it would show 1920x1080 while running 1024x768.

Optional: a literal '1920 X 1080' button whose action is setcvar ui_r_mode -1; setcvar r_customwidth 1920; setcvar r_customheight 1080; show applyChanges.
titles.fix_source: Already in the tree: copy and edit the four .menu files from base/assets1.pk3 and base/assets3.pk3. Nothing needs downloading. No community JKA fix exists on the share (case-insensitive search of /mnt/retro-share/Files, depth 4, found only the JKA ISOs). OpenJK, which has a proper mode list, cannot run on XP: subsystem 6.0 and VC140 imports, per the tree's README-FLEET.txt.
titles.fix_risk:
Low. The change is client-side data only.
- Multiplayer: jka-server runs sv_pure 0, so the pk3 stays loaded while connected. On a pure third-party server it would simply not load.
- A syntax error in a .menu silently breaks that whole menu, so SP and MP menus both need checking.
- Using the 1.00 ui/jamp/setup.menu from assets1 instead of the assets3 copy would undo the 1.01 menu changes.
- GAMESYNC never deletes, so removing the pk3 later needs a launcher-side delete.
- The launcher rewrites fleetres.cfg at every start, so a player's in-menu pick does not survive the next launch. That is by design.
- The HUD and menus stay 640x480-virtual stretched to 16:9. That is an engine limit and unchanged.
titles.hw_check:
Use .145: it is XP, where GDI captures fullscreen, and it has DAEMON Tools for the disc check. .123 cannot launch JKA (no mounter). Do not use .195 for frames (Win7 cannot capture exclusive fullscreen).

1. EXEC cmd /c start "" /D "C:\Games\JediAcademy" "Play Jedi Academy.bat", then the same for "Play Jedi Academy - Multiplayer.bat".
2. WINLIST must show the jasp or jamp window at 0,0 1920x1080. Capture a frame with SCREENSHOT 0 or the staged F11 screenshotJPEG.
3. Main menu > SETUP (opens on the Video tab) > 'Video Mode'. Today this line shows an empty value. After the fix it must read 'Custom' with 1920/1080 shown, and cycling the item must reach that entry.

The menus are relative-mouse: UICLICK is ignored (README-FLEET.txt), so cycling the item needs a person. The agent can at least open the SP setup menu from the console with 'uimenu setupMenu' ('uimenu' is used by jasp.exe itself). The console only accepts synthetic keys in a window, so relaunch with +set r_fullscreen 0 to type, then confirm fullscreen again. For MP, 'ui_openmenu setup_menu' may work: the string is present in uix86.dll, but whether it is a console command is unverified.
titles.verifier_notes: I did not test anything on a box in this phase. The 1920x1080 launch result comes from PER-TITLE-STATUS (.145) plus the sibling GAMERES targets from this session. Every 'no 1080p in the menu' claim was checked against all four menu files, including the 1.01 override in assets3.pk3.

titles.title: SoldierOfFortune2
titles.engine:
Raven id Tech 3 (Team Arena era), two different engines:
- sof2mp.exe 'SOF2MP GOLD V1.03' (MP): game directory base\MP, config base\MP\sof2mp.cfg, UI vm/sof2mp_ui.qvm in base/update103.pk3.
- SoF2.exe (SP): config base\sof2sp.cfg, Raven RMF menus.
Both have the same table, modes 0-11 (11 = 856x480 wide). Neither has a 1920x1080 entry.
titles.launch_sets:
Result: a 4:3 mode that the panel stretches or pillarboxes.
- r_mode 7 (1152x864) on .123, .145 and .240.
- r_mode 6 (1024x768) on .195, whose HD 5450 does not offer 1152x864.

How: both launchers call FLEETRES.BAT and write the shared base\fleetres.cfg with: seta r_mode "%FR_Q3MODE%", r_fullscreen 1, r_displayRefresh %FR_HZ%, cg_fov %FR_FOV%. The SP launcher also writes r_customaspect and r_customPixelAspect. Both pass +set r_mode %FR_Q3MODE% +set r_fullscreen 1 +set cg_fov %FR_FOV%. base\autoexec.cfg (SP) and base\MP\autoexec.cfg (MP) both end 'exec fleetres.cfg'. At sync time the agent writes the same file (gameres.h 'idtech3-index' body).

State of the staged tree: present and current per stage-fleetres --check. PER-TITLE-STATUS records the MP window measured at 1152x864 on .145.

Side defect: cg_fov is 106 on the 16:9 boxes. That is a hor+ FOV applied to a 4:3 render; RTCW's launcher deliberately drops cg_fov for this reason.

Shortcuts: the SP shortcut needs the sofii_1 mount, so it is suppressed on .123. The MP shortcut needs no disc.
titles.menu_source:
Hardcoded in both halves; neither list has 1920x1080.

MP: update101.pk3 ui/setup_display.menu, identical to the mp.pk3 copy it overrides. Item 'videomode_multi' is bound directly to r_mode: cvarFloatList { "512*384" 2 "640*480" 3 "800*600" 4 "960*720" 5 "1024*768" 6 "1152*864" 7 "1280*1024" 8 "1600*1200" 9 }.

SP: Raven RMF menu, therest.pk3 menus/m_video.rmf: <list "&MENU_VIDEO_VIDMODES&" ... cvar menu_mode match "3,4,6,7,8,9">. The labels come from update101.pk3 Strip/menu_video.sp, where VIDMODES = "640x480,800x600,1024x768,1152x864,1280x1024,1600x1200". menus/video_init.cfg does 'set menu_mode $r_mode'; video_apply.cfg does 'set r_mode $menu_mode' then vid_restart.

Even a -1 entry would not help MP today: the engine clamps r_mode to the range 3..10.
titles.evidence:
All evidence is in /home/voidsstr/development/retro-agent/.claude/evidence-1080p/idtech3-jka-sof2-rtcw/.

sof2mp-r_mode-clamp.disasm.txt (sof2mp.exe md5 0263922b67e3474f9e77e769f217f53a):
- R_Register at 0x4BA614 pushes 10.0f, then 3.0f, then 0x2021 for Cvar_Get("r_mode","3",0x2021,min 3,max 10). Raw bytes at file offset 0xBA614: 68 00 00 20 41 68 00 00 40 40 68 21 20 00 00. This pattern occurs exactly once.
- Cvar_Get's existing-cvar path (0x44B3B2-0x44B443): for flag 0x2000, a value below min is forced to min with Cvar_Set2(name,"%g",force), and a value above max is forced to max. So a -1 set from the command line or any cfg becomes 3 (640x480), and 11 becomes 10 (2048x1536).
- R_GetModeInfo (0x4B98A0) does contain the mode == -1 branch at 0x4B98B7. It reads r_customwidth [0x11A6498] and r_customheight [0x11A6384], both registered with no range. The branch is unreachable because of the clamp.

sof2sp-r_mode.disasm.txt (SoF2.exe md5 c0c873320da54b0d191041ba942ab28e):
- r_mode is registered with a plain 3-argument Cvar_Get("r_mode","3",0x21); there is no min/max.
- The -1 branch at 0x1008FC57 is live.
- On a failed mode set, the engine does Cvar_SetValue r_mode 3 and retries.

Other files:
- sof2-menu-modelists.txt: both menu lists.
- sof2mp-ui-qvm-r_mode.txt: sof2mp_ui.qvm references r_mode only inside the graphics-preset string block.

The fleet sof2-server config has seta sv_pure 0 and sv_punkbuster 0 (/home/voidsstr/sof2-server/base/server.cfg).
titles.fix:
Multiplayer: no config route exists. The smallest change is a 4-byte patch to base-tree sof2mp.exe at file offset 0xBA61A: change 00 00 40 40 (3.0f, the r_mode minimum pushed at VA 0x4BA619) to 00 00 80 BF (-1.0f). With that, r_mode -1 survives Cvar_Get and reaches the -1 branch that is already in R_GetModeInfo, and r_customwidth/r_customheight size the mode. Then three follow-ups:
1. Move SoF2 MP back to the standard idiom in both the launcher and gameres.h: r_mode -1 + r_customwidth %FR_W% + r_customheight %FR_H%, and remove it from IDTECH3_NO_CUSTOM_MODE.
2. Add a `"Custom" -1` (or "1920*1080" -1) entry to ui/setup_display.menu, built from update101.pk3's copy, in an override pk3 in base\ that sorts last.
3. Keep cg_fov 106, which is right once the render is really 16:9.

Alternative for MP: a community 'Soldier of Fortune 2 Multiplayer Widescreen Patch' (PCGamingWiki community file 1141). It is not on the share, and its contents are unverified: the page returned 403. The web summary says it needs 640x480 selected, which suggests it rewrites the mode-3 table entry.

Single player: no binary change is needed. SoF2.exe honours -1 and has no clamp.
1. Have the SP launcher pass +set r_mode -1 +set r_customwidth %FR_W% +set r_customheight %FR_H%, and write those values to an SP-only cfg exec'd from base\autoexec.cfg (which only SP reads). Never put -1 in the shared base\fleetres.cfg: sof2mp.exe execs it too and would clamp -1 to 640x480.
2. Override menus/m_video.rmf to `match "3,4,6,7,8,9,-1"` and Strip/menu_video.sp to VIDMODES "...,1600x1200,Custom" in the same pk3.
titles.fix_source: The patch bytes were derived here from the staged sof2mp.exe; nothing needs downloading. The menu sources are already in the tree: base/update101.pk3 (ui/setup_display.menu, Strip/menu_video.sp) and base/therest.pk3 (menus/m_video.rmf). The community MP patch would have to be downloaded from community.pcgamingwiki.com/files/file/1141, and its contents are unverified. The share has only sof2goldfull.exe (the Gold installer); a case-insensitive search found no SoF2 fix there.
titles.fix_risk:
Multiplayer exe patch:
- It modifies the retail binary; keep the original under _patches.
- The PE CheckSum field is 0 and the only overlay is the NB10 PDB-path record, so the binary does not check itself.
- The file size stays the same. GAMESYNC compares size and mtime, so the patched file only propagates if its mtime changes. Publish it through gvfs; smbclient stamps Oct 2007 and the edit would then be skipped everywhere. Verify the md5 on a box afterwards.
- PunkBuster is off at both ends and the fleet server runs sv_pure 0 with Raven's Linux sof2ded. Q3-family servers check pk3s, not the client exe, but a join test is still required.
- At 16:9 the 640x480-virtual HUD and menus will stretch.
- The MP UI's graphics presets (ui_glCustom) most likely rewrite r_mode when a player picks one. That is an inference from the qvm string table; the qvm was not disassembled, so whether the UI registers its own r_mode range is unknown.

Single-player route: low risk. RMF parsing of a -1 list value is untested.
titles.hw_check:
Multiplayer (on .145 or .123, both XP; MP needs no disc):
1. Run 'Play Soldier of Fortune II - Multiplayer.bat'. Today WINLIST shows a 'SoF2 MP' window at 1152x864, and base\MP\sof2mp.cfg keeps r_mode "7".
2. After the patch and idiom change, run 'gfxinfo' or a condump. It must read MODE -1 and '...setting mode -1: 1920 1080 FS', and WINLIST must show 1920x1080 fullscreen.
3. Menu: Main > SETUP > DISPLAY > 'Video Mode:' must show the new entry.

The SoF2 menus are relative-mouse (CLAUDE.md: SoF2's menus cannot be automated), so a person has to cycle the item. The console only takes synthetic keys in a window, so do any typing windowed and verify fullscreen afterwards. For frames, use F11 (screenshotJPEG, lands in base\MP\screenshots) or SCREENSHOT 0 on XP.

Single player (on .145, which has DAEMON Tools for the sofii_1 disc): Options > Video > Resolution in the RMF menu, which is mouse-driven.
titles.verifier_notes:
This refutes the stated mechanism but confirms the outcome for multiplayer. PER-TITLE-STATUS, gameres.h and the launcher comments say SoF2 has 'no r_mode -1 branch'. The branch exists in both binaries.
- MP is blocked by the Cvar_Get range 3..10. This also means the base\MP\autoexec.cfg table note is wrong about index 11: r_mode 11 becomes 2048x1536, not 856x480.
- SP is not blocked at all, and the SP half was never measured.
Web background only, not used as evidence: search results say SoF2 MP 'r_mode won't go below 3, limits 3 to 10' while SP custom 1920x1200 works. That matches the binaries.

titles.title: ReturnToCastleWolfenstein
titles.engine:
id Tech 3 (Gray Matter/Nerve), GOG build 2.0.0.2:
- WolfSP.exe 'Wolf 1.32', dated May 1 2002. Its table covers modes 0-12, and 12 is 1920x1200 (wide).
- WolfMP.exe 'Wolf 1.4-MP' (1.41, Oct 28 2002). Its table covers modes 0-11.
UIs: uix86.dll (SP) and ui_mp_x86.dll (MP, in mp_bin.pk3). Configs: Main\wolfconfig.cfg and Main\wolfconfig_mp.cfg.
Both engines register r_mode with a plain 3-argument Cvar_Get, and neither range-checks it.
titles.launch_sets:
Result:
- 1152x864 (r_mode 7, 4:3) on .123, .145 and .240.
- 1024x768 (r_mode 6) on .195.
- Exception: the first launch of each engine on a freshly synced tree comes up at 640x480. No wolfconfig(.cfg/_mp.cfg) is staged, so com_recommendedSet is 0. At the end of Com_Init the engine calls Com_SetRecommended, which execs one of highVidhighCPU, highVidlowCPU, lowVidhighCPU or lowVidlowCPU.cfg from pak0.pk3; all four say 'seta r_mode 3'. It then appends vid_restart. This runs after default.cfg, wolfconfig, autoexec.cfg (and so fleetres.cfg) and the command line, so it overrides all of them once.

How the normal launches get their mode: all four launchers ('Play Return to Castle Wolfenstein', 'Play RTCW Multiplayer', 'Host RTCW - LAN', 'Join RTCW - LAN') call FLEETRES.BAT. Each writes Main\fleetres.cfg with seta r_mode "%FR_Q3MODE%", r_fullscreen 1, r_displayRefresh %FR_HZ% (no cg_fov) and passes +set r_mode %FR_Q3MODE% +set r_fullscreen 1. Main\autoexec.cfg execs fleetres.cfg. At sync time the agent writes the same file (gameres.h 'idtech3-index-nofov').

State of the staged tree: present and current per stage-fleetres --check. However, it rests on the premise 'r_mode -1 does not exist in this engine', which the binaries contradict.
titles.menu_source:
A hardcoded cvarFloatList bound directly to r_mode.

SP: sp_pak3.pk3, which overrides sp_pak1:
- ui/system.menu: { "640*480" 3 "800*600" 4 "960*720" 5 "1024*768" 6 "1152*864" 7 "1280*1024" 8 "1600*1200" 9 "2048*1536" 10 "856*480 Wide Screen" 11 }
- ui/ingame_system.menu: the same values, with 'x' labels.

MP: mp_pak1.pk3 ui_mp/system.menu and ui_mp/ingame_system.menu carry the same list, plus german, french, italian and spanish copies.

None lists 1920x1080. WolfSP.exe's own table has 'Mode 12: 1920x1200 (wide)', which no menu lists.
titles.evidence:
All evidence is in /home/voidsstr/development/retro-agent/.claude/evidence-1080p/idtech3-jka-sof2-rtcw/.

rtcw-r_mode-and-first-run.disasm.txt:
- WolfMP (md5 6ad8aceea02dc1eef8af0c73331cddaf): R_Register at 0x45AB07 is Cvar_Get("r_mode","3",0x21), stored at [0x1224318]. r_customwidth ("1600") goes to [0x1224324] and r_customheight ("1024") to [0x12242D8].
- WolfMP R_GetModeInfo: the mode == -1 branch at 0x459C27 reads r_customwidth and r_customheight.
- WolfMP AssertCvarRange (0x45B490) is called only for r_picmip, r_displayRefresh and r_znear, never for r_mode.
- WolfMP first-run code at 0x420AEB: if com_recommendedSet == 0 and not safe mode, it calls 0x420610 (Com_SetRecommended) and then Cbuf_ExecuteText(APPEND, "vid_restart").
- WolfSP (md5 dd1f541307ce485076628cadae3637fa): the same pattern. The -1 branch is at 0x445E17, and Com_SetRecommended(1) ends with Cbuf_AddText("vid_restart\n").
- The file also contains the four cfg bodies.

rtcw-menu-modelists.txt: the menu lists.

rtcw-sp-1.42d-patch.txt: the share patch listing, PE info, its 36-mode table (26 = 1920x1080 wide) and its menus, which include 'Custom' -1 ... '1920*1080 WS' 26 plus r_customwidth and r_customheight fields. The patch ships Main/sp_pak4.pk3 (66,821 B), which collides with the staged 15,532,040 B GOG sp_pak4.pk3 (map updates: crypt1, dam, end...).

The fleet rtcw-server (ioRTCW) runs sv_pure 0 (scripts/game-servers/rtcw/server.cfg).
titles.fix:
Both engines: add `seta com_recommendedSet "1"` to the staged Main\autoexec.cfg, or pass +set com_recommendedSet 1 on each launcher. This stops the first launch after a sync from being forced to 640x480.

Single player: stage Knightmare's unofficial RTCW SP 1.42d, which is already on the share.
1. Copy WolfSP.exe ('Wolf 1.42d': PE SubsystemVersion 5.0, statically linked, system imports only), cgamex86.dll, qagamex86.dll and uix86.dll to the tree root.
2. Copy its Main/sp_pak4.pk3 under a new name that sorts after sp_pak4.pk3, e.g. Main\sp_pak4b.pk3. Never overwrite the staged GOG sp_pak4.pk3.
3. Its menus then list '1920*1080 WS' (r_mode 26) and 'Custom' (-1) with Width/Height fields.
4. Switch the SP launcher to +set r_mode -1 +set r_customwidth %FR_W% +set r_customheight %FR_H%. Above index 7 the 1.42d table differs from stock (8 = 1280x960), so FR_Q3MODE must never exceed 7 with it.

Multiplayer: no widescreen patch is on the share, but retail WolfMP.exe 1.41 already honours r_mode -1.
1. Stage an override pk3 in Main\ that sorts after mp_pak*.pk3, holding ui_mp/system.menu and ui_mp/ingame_system.menu from mp_pak1.pk3 with a `"Custom" -1` (or "1920*1080" -1) entry added.
2. After one hardware A/B, remove RTCW from IDTECH3_NO_CUSTOM_MODE and gameres.h 'idtech3-index-nofov', and use r_mode -1 + FR_W/FR_H in all four launchers.
titles.fix_source: The SP patch is on the share: /mnt/retro-share/Files/Game Updates/RTCW/rtcw-sp-1.42d-win32-bin.zip (md5 482be194a3ebf4d0c1eb9ca664834838). The MP menu sources are already in the tree (Main/mp_pak1.pk3). An alternative also on the share, not required: Game Updates/iortcw-1.51c-win-x86.zip (ioRTCW 1.51c: subsystem 4.0, msvcrt and SDL2, supports custom modes, but it ships the same stock 640-2048 menus).
titles.fix_risk:
SP 1.42d:
- The binaries are unofficial (not id or Activision) and untested on the fleet.
- The sp_pak4.pk3 name collision is real: following the patch readme literally would silently revert the GOG map updates.
- Old SP saves may not load. Menus are relaid out with 'scralign'.
- GAMESYNC never deletes, so a rollback means restaging the originals; keep them under _patches.

MP menu pk3:
- Client-side only. The ioRTCW server runs sv_pure 0, so the pk3 stays loaded while connected.
- The retail 1.41 MP HUD and menus are 640x480-virtual and will stretch at 16:9. The FOV is vert- unless cg_fov is raised.
- Picking a Graphics preset in the MP UI resets r_mode for that session: ui_mp_x86.dll calls Cvar_SetValue r_mode 4 or 3 at 0x4000D2AB, 0x4000D377 and 0x4000D500.

com_recommendedSet 1: skips the one-time preset pass, so picmip and similar settings stay at engine defaults. Harmless.
titles.hw_check:
Use .145 (XP, GDI captures fullscreen).

1. Purge the title, run GAMESYNC, then launch 'Play RTCW Multiplayer.bat' twice.
   - Expected first launch: WINLIST shows 640x480, and Main\wolfconfig_mp.cfg gains seta r_mode "3" and com_recommendedSet "1".
   - Expected second launch: the FR_Q3MODE size (1152x864). This proves the first-run cause.
2. With com_recommendedSet 1 staged, launch with r_mode -1, r_customwidth 1920, r_customheight 1080. WINLIST must show 1920x1080 fullscreen, and a condump must read '...setting mode -1: 1920 1080 FS'.
3. Menu: Main > OPTIONS > SYSTEM > 'Video Mode' (in game: ESC > OPTIONS > SYSTEM) must show the new entry. With SP 1.42d it must show 'Custom' with Width/Height 1920/1080, and cycling must reach '1920*1080 WS'.

The RTCW menus are relative-mouse (the MP limbo menu was measured on .143: UICLICK is not followed), and RTCW has no console command to open a menu, so a person has to navigate. The staged F12 bind ('screenshot', lands in Main\screenshots\shotNNNN.tga) gives the frame.
titles.verifier_notes:
This contradicts IDTECH3_NO_CUSTOM_MODE in stage-fleetres.py and gameres.h's 'SoF2 and RTCW both carry r_customwidth and honour neither'. From the binaries alone, both RTCW engines honour r_mode -1.

The .246 note says the game 'came up 640x480 and wrote back seta r_mode "3" beside an intact r_customwidth "1920"'.
